subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finservcorp.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today. Appreciate the clarity on your evaluation goals. Per our call, I’m sending a short recap and a proposed POC plan so your team can review before we lock dates. Key items below.

What we demoed
- Redwood inference API: low-latency generation and embedding flows
- Dedicated routing for cost/latency tradeoffs and private VPC option
- Observability + evals workflow for quality/regression monitoring

FinServCorp evaluation goals (as discussed)
- Validate latency at 99th pct for typical request mix (<= 450ms)
- Measure per-token cost for 10k daily active users
- Confirm SSO + data retention policies meet compliance needs
- Ensure output quality on 5 core prompt flows (customer support, KYC summarization, SLA drafting, transaction classification, anonymization)

Proposed 4-week POC (outline)
1) Week 0 (kickoff): project kickoff, scope, access & test dataset exchange
2) Week 1: baseline integration — connect API, run smoke tests, ingest sample data
3) Week 2: scale tests & latency profiling, cost measurements, initial quality checks
4) Week 3: targeted evals on 5 prompt flows, regression checks, tweak config
5) Week 4: final report, recommendations, decision checklist

Success criteria (example)
- Latency: 99th percentile <= 450ms on your sample workload
- Quality: pass weighted accuracy thresholds in evaluation (details in attached evaluation-metrics.xlsx)
- Security/compliance: SSO + data retention align with your reqs, SOC2 evidence provided

Owners / roles
- FinServCorp: Alice Johnson (POC lead), Tom Ellis (infra)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (sales/eng liaison), Neha Kapoor (CSM, day-to-day), Rachel Kim (solutions engineer)

Next steps / asks
- Please confirm the POC scope & success criteria by EOD Monday (Dec 7)
- Share a small representative dataset and any compliance questionnaire (if you want, upload to the Drive link above)
- If the plan looks good, pick a 60–90 minute kickoff slot here: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/finserv-poc-kickoff

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf, evaluation-metrics.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to running this together.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finservcorp.com>

Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finservcorp.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the POC plan — that matches our expectations. A few quick questions from our side before we confirm:

1) SSO: can Redwood integrate with our Okta instance (SAML)? We’ll need SSO for the admin console and audit logs.
2) Data retention: we need the option to set retention to 30/90/365 days for test data. Is that configurable per project?
3) SOC2: can you share the SOC2 report or a SOC2 summary? We’ll need it for procurement.

We’ll want to include our security compliance lead and procurement. I’ll loop them in once we have answers. Tentatively we can do kickoff the week of Dec 14; prefer Dec 15 afternoon.

I’ve attached a short list of questions we collected during the demo (FinServCorp-questions.docx).

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Product Manager — Data & AI
FinServCorp
alice.johnson@finservcorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finservcorp.com>

Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — FinServCorp

Hi Alice — great questions, answers below and happy to jump on a quick call with your security lead if helpful.

1) SSO: Yes — we support SAML SSO via Okta for the admin console and for SSO-based user provisioning. We’ll send a short admin SAML setup doc in a follow-up.
2) Data retention: Configurable at the project level. You can choose 30/90/365 day policies; we’ll include instructions in the onboarding checklist.
3) SOC2: attaching a SOC2 summary in a separate email to your procurement contact; if you need the full report we can share under NDA.

Kickoff: Dec 15 afternoon works. I penciled in Dec 15, 13:00–14:30 PT on the Calendly link — can you confirm?

Owners: Neha will be the primary CSM to run day-to-day POC activity; Rachel will own the integration and evals. Neha — can you own the kickoff & onboarding checklist (access, test dataset exchange, gauntlet)?

Attachments: I added the FinServCorp-questions.docx to our folder and reattached the evaluation-metrics.xlsx for clarity.

Best,
Marissa
